deliberate_departures: The shared light palette replaces the sample warm paper colors; white sheets separate through palette-colored borders and restrained offset shadows.
The sample serif typography is replaced by the required Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif family.
Small sheet rotations preserve the paper-layer construction; Japanese text stays horizontal for compact target readability.
Composition-specific pattern and MAKE motifs are omitted because they would add unrelated meaning to these five scenarios.
font_limitations: Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif is declared in every SVG. Fonts are not embedded; the font actually selected and fallback or missing-glyph behavior depend on the viewing host and have not been verified.
checks: All five SVGs parsed as XML; viewBox and explicit dimensions match the supplied CSS targets. Original example light and dark PNGs were actually viewed. No browser render or visual acceptance is claimed.
